chapter_title: Concerning the Five Things that he constructed wit
spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

** ¶1. ** The Divine Wisdom acting through spiritual power established five fundamental orderings of the spiritual world, drawing them from the pathways through which interior life flows and from the outermost structural tru ths — the most fixed and ultimate forms — that give rigid support to all that exists above them.

**¶2. ** The first is the complete found ational plane of truth that rests upon the sustaining power of the one who bears all things — that is , the capacity of Divine truth in its lowest and most ultimate degree to carry and up hold every state that depends upon it.

**¶3 .** The second is the connective framework of supporting truths that stand in the presence of that sustaining power — truths that arch and bind the higher degrees to the lower, so that what is above may rest sec urely upon what is below.

** ¶4.** The third is the constraining structure imposed upon the hells — the determining boundary by which states of falsity and evil are held in fixed form and prevented from over flowing their limits .

**¶5.** The fourth is the complete series of fundamental supporting truths established throughout the vast expanse of natural knowledge, standing firm in every region of the spiritual universe — seven pillars because they extend through the whole of what is, lacking nothing.

**¶6.** The fifth is the protective doctrine of truth enc los ing on every side the receiving forms of the mind — the four walls being truth facing every quarter , so that the vessels in which good and truth are held may be defended from invasion and preserved in their integrity.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: The Living Spirit constructed five great things from veins and skull[s in the] hard [bodies].
The first is the disc that is placed upon [the sh]oulder of the Porter.
The se[con]d are the arches of [the] pillar that is before him.
[The th]ird is the [mou]ld of the fo[r]m for the gehennas.
The fourth are the [seven] pillars that he has erected in the great sea, in [the] seven parts of the universe.
The fifth are the four walls that surround the vessels.
